purpose: Agent setup recipes, not an automatic installer or permission grant.
versionPolicy: Reuse compatible installed/project-pinned versions. Resolve and record a supported exact release before a new install; provenance commit pins are source-review evidence, not asserted package versions. Homebrew formulas are moving releases: inspect and disclose the resolved version before approval. Never silently upgrade or reinstall.

tools.name: Legion Apple native CLI/MCP
tools.scope: native Rust binary or MCP registration
tools.useWhen: typed Apple discovery, project/SwiftPM build plans, simulator/device, debugging, profiling, build analysis, docs and App Store Connect
tools.setupRecipe: Reuse the installed Legion binary or connected legion_apple MCP capability; do not install Python or an external adapter for native routes
tools.verify: legion apple catalog --input '{}'; legion apple preflight --input '{"list":true}'; MCP legion_apple operation=catalog
tools.versionPolicy: Use repository-compatible Legion binary; catalog is local and plans are dry-run until execute=true

tools.name: MobileBuildMCP (formerly XcodeBuildMCP)
tools.scope: environment binary; MCP client/user or project registration
tools.useWhen: build, test, simulator/device, logs and debugging
tools.setupRecipe: brew tap getsentry/xcodebuildmcp; brew install mobilebuildmcp OR npm install -g mobilebuildmcp@<approved-version>
tools.verify: Before invocation set process MOBILEBUILDMCP_SENTRY_DISABLED=true and inspect higher-priority project/session overrides; mobilebuildmcp --help; mobilebuildmcp tools; inspect actual connected MCP tool schemas
tools.versionPolicy: Preserve a compatible existing XcodeBuildMCP/server; confirm renamed interface, package version and project pin before migration.

tools.name: Xcode command-line tools
tools.useWhen: Xcode project, simulator, device, archive or profiling operation is selected
tools.setupRecipe: Reuse selected DEVELOPER_DIR/Xcode installation; native preflight checks PATH candidate only
tools.verify: legion apple preflight --input '{"tools":["xcode"],"environment":"Darwin"}'; inspect xcodebuild/xcrun versions and SDKs separately
tools.versionPolicy: Use project-compatible Xcode and SDK; PATH presence is not compatibility or authorization evidence.

tools.name: Swift toolchain
tools.useWhen: SwiftPM build, test or run operation is selected
tools.setupRecipe: Reuse installed project-compatible Swift toolchain; native preflight checks PATH candidate only
tools.verify: legion apple preflight --input '{"tools":["swift"]}'; inspect swift --version and Package.swift platform support separately
tools.versionPolicy: Use toolchain supported by package manifest and host; PATH presence is not build evidence.

tools.name: AXe
tools.versionPolicy: Match selected Xcode/simulator runtime and packaged frameworks; check whether MobileBuildMCP already supplies the required AXe capability.

tools.name: DocSetQuery
tools.scope: versioned source checkout; local docsets/cache; project docs
tools.useWhen: local Apple documentation extraction and search
tools.setupRecipe: Optional compatibility path only: reuse an existing approved checkout; native legion apple docs uses local SQLite DocSet data without Python
tools.verify: Prefer legion apple docs catalog/query; if project-selected adapter exists, inspect its checkout and local docset/cache scope
tools.versionPolicy: No package-manager formula or MCP server is assumed. Native Rust docs is primary; external checkout and Python dependencies are optional.

tools.name: xcbeautify
tools.setupRecipe: brew install xcbeautify OR mint install cpisciotta/xcbeautify
tools.versionPolicy: Preserve raw logs and producer exit status (pipefail); no formatter is required to build.

tools.name: Sourcery
tools.scope: environment binary OR existing project dependency/plugin
tools.setupRecipe: brew install sourcery OR use the project-pinned CocoaPods/SPM/Mint/release-binary route
tools.versionPolicy: Keep generator/template/compiler versions compatible; platform/build-method support differs. Do not add build phases, templates or plugins just to install a tool.

tools.name: Inject / InjectionIII
tools.scope: project Swift package/code/debug settings plus developer-machine app
tools.useWhen: requested hot reload in an existing app
tools.setupRecipe: Add approved project-pinned Inject Swift package; follow upstream linked InjectionIII/InjectionForXcode setup for the selected compiler
tools.verify: Inspect Package.resolved/project dependencies, debug linker settings and Injection app version; validate one intended view update
tools.versionPolicy: Project integration is a separate code/settings change. Do not weaken signing/library validation or enable injection on a release target.

tools.name: Xopoko AppStoreConnectCLI (ascctl)
tools.scope: environment binary; separately authorized account profile
tools.setupRecipe: brew tap Xopoko/tap; brew install ascctl
tools.verify: ascctl --help (JSON ok=true); inspect config/auth/openapi help before any account access
tools.versionPolicy: Distinct from asc: do not interchange flags or auth. Use project-compatible release; binary presence does not establish authentication.

tools.name: rorkai App Store Connect CLI (asc)
tools.scope: environment binary; separately authorized account profile
tools.useWhen: release/TestFlight/metadata workflows described by rorkai skills
tools.setupRecipe: brew install asc on a supported Homebrew host; otherwise choose the official signed release asset for OS/architecture
tools.verify: Set ASC_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 for the process before any invocation; asc version; asc --help; inspect selected operation help
tools.versionPolicy: Distinct from ascctl. Existing rorkai playbooks are referenced, not automatically installed; account credentials and release actions need separate authority. Verify the installed version honors telemetry opt-out; default upstream command telemetry is not implied authorization.

tools.name: RocketSim
tools.scope: installed licensed app; environment CLI symlink
tools.setupRecipe: In an authorized existing RocketSim app: Settings > CLI & Agent > Install Command Line Tool; choose an approved PATH directory
tools.verify: rocketsim doctor; inspect current CLI help
tools.versionPolicy: CLI stays inside the app and follows app updates; requires running app and applicable permissions. No purchase or app download is implied.

tools.name: CodexMonitor
tools.setupRecipe: Use official repository release/build instructions only if the user requests this app; preserve current Codex workflow otherwise
tools.verify: Inspect installed app version, repository README and configured Codex CLI/workspace
tools.versionPolicy: Not a build or UI-test prerequisite; never create remote-access services or read unrelated sessions as part of Apple setup.

tools.name: steipete agent-scripts
tools.scope: selected reviewed source files in an approved tools location
tools.useWhen: specific requested helper; profiling methodology already adapted
tools.setupRecipe: Inspect the exact reviewed helper and dependencies in the official repository; copy/fetch only that helper when authorized
tools.verify: Read the selected script before execution and inspect its help where safe
tools.versionPolicy: No install-all command; do not import personal agent rules, browser sessions, credentials, hooks or unrelated orchestration.
